capabilities.name: tag.policy.reporting.read
capabilities.use: Approved metric definitions, thresholds and presentation language.

capabilities.name: tag.data.query
capabilities.use: Read-only queries only, for figures that then pass finance-validate-data.

capabilities.name: tag.evidence.attach
capabilities.use: Record the dashboard file, its hash and the input identities.

capabilities.name: tag.review.request
capabilities.use: Route the dashboard to a reviewer before it is shared.

inputs.name: verified report data
inputs.source: finance-financial-statements report.json, or query results with a finance-validate-data report

inputs.name: audience, purpose, period, entity, language
inputs.source: the user's request and the run context

outputs.name: <name>_dashboard.html
outputs.description: Self-contained dashboard with embedded data, metric definitions and source footer.

outputs.name: dashboard note
outputs.description: Sources, verification references, definitions, open exceptions, CDN use.

runtime.name: chart.js (optional, CDN)
runtime.purpose: only with the upstream Chart.js template; loaded by the viewer's browser from cdn.jsdelivr.net with an integrity hash

runtime.name: chartjs-adapter-date-fns (optional, CDN)
runtime.purpose: only with the upstream Chart.js template, for time axes

conditions: Before the dashboard is shared outside the finance function or the organization.
When any displayed figure comes from a blocked report or carries an open exception.
